results.content: Donald Trump's popularity rebounded slightly in this week's Economist / YouGov Poll after his recent slump, but he remains deeply unpopular. This week's poll finds that 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, and 57% disapprove — a net job approval of -21. That's an improvement for Trump from the week before, when 35% approved and 61% disapproved for a net approval of -26. Two weeks ago, Trump hit the lowest job approval numbers of either of his terms: 33% [...] A big component of Trump's increase in net job approval over the past week is a rise in support from Independents, who rose from a net approval of -53 last week to -38 this week. Donald Trump’s net approval rating remains in the dumps at -26, according to The Economist’s tracker of YouGov polling. On September 9th the president will begin a two-day rally in Dallas, Texas—an oddity outside a presidential-election year. The jamboree is intended to gin up Republican support ahead of the midterms. Perhaps the organisers have been watching Mr Trump’s poll numbers. Seemingly worried about low-attendance, the party has been offering free tickets. [...] Methodology
